World: International news and politics: governments, elections, diplomacy, wars and conflicts, terrorism, disasters and events in specific countries. Not business deals or sports events that happen abroad.
Sports: Sports competitions, teams, athletes, coaches, scores, tournaments, leagues, transfers and the Olympics.
Business: Companies, markets and the economy: earnings, stocks, mergers and acquisitions, oil prices, interest rates, jobs, trade and corporate strategy, including technology companies when the story is about their finances or deals.
Science and Technology: Science, technology and the internet: research discoveries, space, health and medical science, computers, software, gadgets, video games, telecommunications and product launches.
